svg.title: Section segmentation revision and pooled clustering dependencies
svg.desc: A schematic preview of revising segmentation in section A. Prepared image and accepted tissue inputs remain reusable in both sections. Section A requires a replacement segmentation population A-prime and new per-cell measurements. Section B retains its segmentation and measurements. Both measurement tables enter one pooled clustering calculation, so its shared result and both section-specific label tables require recomputation. The outer paths also carry each section's measured cell rows to its labels. A-prime-1 through A-prime-3 and B1 through B3 are schematic cell identities, not population sizes. Blank feature and label slots show pending results; no resulting cluster assignments are asserted. The preview itself does not run these calculations or replace saved results.
